After becoming Lord of the Obelask region in Western Estor, Tyran Obliteras, Champion of Vulcan, fell to the dark forces of the Abyss, corrupting him and his connection to the War God. He was hunted and defeated by Vulcan's new champion Melantha Celestia-Shield, and her allies known as the Young Wolves.
